method: fixed target-host denominator plus driver-verified execution witness status=probed captured evidence only; classifier re-checks witness nonce/probe/payload hash structure and the driver proof shape (strace execve/stdout, strace execve/fdwrite, or Codex JSON command_execution); governed default-mode self-disable evidence can close only that named operation and is not root execution proof; R4 can score only from an explicit authoritative receipt-root attack result; nonce-only self-reports and fixture/contract results are excluded by construction
exclusion_rule: attack-suite.js results validate the PROPOSED CONTRACT against a disposable fixture and are deliberately NOT an input here. A sound contract does not qualify a host.
